versions.content: Frame preemption status classification of pre- emptable Ethernet frames on egress per traffic class Status: DRAFT If EthSwtFramePreemptionEnable is set to TRUE for an EthSwtPort, then all Ethernet frames in the EthSwtPortQueues of the corresponding EthSwt- PortEgress are classified as preemptable Ethernet frames, where the EthSwt- TrafficClassToPreemptionStatusAssignment is set to ETHSWT_TRAFFIC_- CLASS_PREEMPTABLE.
